description: Send one OpenAI chat completions request to a compatible endpoint, reading an optional Bearer key from --key-env NAME in this process; returns the assistant message, usage and the model that answered. Errors: ArgumentsBad, KeyBad, EndpointFailed, ReplyBad. Agents normally do not call this: their brain goes through the llm kernel.

key_env.description: environment variable name to read the Bearer key from in this process; optional; if omitted, unset or empty, no Authorization header is sent (an HTTP 401/403 reply then names the unset variable); a value with non-ASCII, space or control characters is KeyBad

endpoint.description: one endpoint: url (up to /v1), model, fixed (optional fields that override the request); model always comes from here; key is not accepted; optional connect_timeout_s (connect, TLS and sending, default 10) and read_timeout_s (longest wait with no reply data, default 900), seconds, 0 = no limit; optional api: "chat" (default, url/chat/completions) or "responses" (url/responses; request and reply converted; a function tool without strict is sent with strict false, so optional parameters stay optional)

request.description: an OpenAI chat completions body without the endpoint: messages required; tools, temperature, model optional

reasoning_effort.description: set by the llm kernel when the letter names one the pack offers; api chat = the request's reasoning_effort parameter, api responses = a configuration_update item at the end of the input (the prompt cache stays)

priority.description: set by the llm kernel; if priority.deadline (epoch seconds) is given, every wait ends 1 s before it; a timeout is EndpointFailed with retry true
